jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Leafy vegetables production guide (Kenya)

varieties.name: Fordhook Giant (Swiss chard)
varieties.supplier_notes: The market's default 'spinach' — thick stalks, weekly re-harvest for months.

varieties.name: Bloomsdale Longstanding
varieties.supplier_notes: True spinach: crinkly dark leaves, slower to bolt.

timeline_template.description_en: Work in well-rotted manure or compost — leafy crops live on soil fertility.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka samadi iliyooza — mboga za majani zinaishi kwa rutuba ya udongo.

timeline_template.description_en: Direct-sow 1 cm deep (2-4 kg per acre) or transplant seedlings at 30cm × 20cm. Basal: 50 kg DAP.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda moja kwa moja kina cha 1 cm (kilo 2-4 kwa eka) au pandikiza 30cm × 20cm. Weka kilo 50 za DAP.

timeline_template.description_en: First weeding — these crops have zero patience for weed competition.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwanza — mboga hizi hazivumilii magugu hata kidogo.

timeline_template.description_en: Top-dress 50 kg CAN per acre. Leaf crops are nitrogen engines — repeat week 5 and 7.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 50 za CAN. Mboga za majani zinahitaji nitrojeni — rudia wiki 5 na 7.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut outer leaves at 15-20 cm, leave the crown — the plant re-grows for repeated cuts.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata majani ya nje sentimita 15-20, acha kichwa — mmea unachipua tena.
timeline_template.tip_en: Sell the same day — these leaves do not wait.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Uza siku hiyohiyo — majani haya hayasubiri.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunch by freshness; reject yellowed, holed, or wilted leaves.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 100 g bunches for retail; crates for bulk kitchen supply.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day — pick in the cool morning and bunch immediately.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Uza siku hiyohiyo — vuna asubuhi na funga mara moja.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; check undersides of young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; chunguza chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Natural enemies first — scout before spraying.
diseases.prevention_sw: Maadui wa asili kwanza — chunguza kabla ya dawa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery winding tunnels through the leaf; cosmetic but costly at market.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Michirizi ya fedha ndani ya jani; hudhuru sura sokoni.
diseases.treatment_en: Remove and destroy mined leaves; registered products at threshold only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ondoa majani yaliyoathirika; dawa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Backlit photo shows the tunnel track.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow patches above, grey-purple fuzz below, cool humid spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu, ukungu wa kijivu chini, baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered downy-active fungicide at first specks. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Wide spacing, morning watering, resistant varieties.
diseases.prevention_sw: Nafasi ya kutosha, mwagilia asubuhi, aina sugu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo required — fuzz invisible from above.

diseases.symptoms_en: Round grey-brown spots with dark borders, older leaves first.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kijivu-kahawia yenye mipaka meusi, majani makubwa kwanza.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered contact fungicide at first spots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Round spots with distinct borders vs mildew fuzz.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Demand never pauses — hotels, hospitals, households buy daily. One acre sold weekly is a payroll, not a harvest.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mahitaji hayapumziki — hoteli na kaya hununua kila siku. Eka moja inayouzwa kila wiki ni mshahara, si mavuno.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 40–80 KES per kg retail, or 20–50 KES per bunch (November 2026). Input bill 10,000–15,000 KES per acre.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 40–80 kwa kilo rejareja, au 20–50 kwa fungu (Novemba 2026). Gharama 10,000–15,000 KES kwa eka.
